extraction.schema_binding: Per-request enum of authenticated accepted-body evidence aliases; exact schema and body hashes in prepared plan.
extraction.requests: one per unique canonical opportunity exact cache miss; shared opportunities once
extraction.assembly_provenance: September 2 opportunity-only v1 provisioning recipe: generic helpers promoted; benchmark population, call cap and manual replay lookup removed.

evidence.source: Explicit immutable local snapshot; active variants or all nonpending nonsimulation variants if none active, via existing load_semantic_input. No sampling or refresh.
evidence.acceptance: verify_job_source_acceptance_integrity plus complete versioned_accepted, healthy_body, promoted, nonsample, body-present accepted/LKG bindings.
evidence.authentication: Canonical scope, input/source/capture hashes, exact body equality, capture provenance and accepted quote/alias validation.
evidence.provider_blinding: Original v1 allowlist and evidence text; neutral opportunity:Vnnn local variant aliases; no global IDs or provider metadata.
evidence.trust_boundary: Server-created frozen evidence only. Caller preserves source snapshot/hash and verifies freeze manifest before preparation/execution; no uncheckpointed WAL source.
evidence.missing: Unavailable packet; no new eligibility gate or repair.

cache.additional_immutability: All transitive dependencies/environment pinned by this method identity and verified before execution.
cache.hit: Only exact key; verify identity, receipt, raw-output/integrity hashes; rebuild packet and preserve provenance; valid empty results are hits.
cache.miss: Missing, stale, incompatible or corrupt artifact; no approximate lookup/manual selection; prepare one extraction.
cache.cache_admission: Completed provider receipt matching exact endpoint/model-requested/config/body; explicit replay fixture without this provenance is never automatically admitted.
cache.existing_entries: Never overwrite. Failed cache write does not remove the packet.
cache.historical_replay: Explicit checksum-allowlisted saved fixture replay only; no automatic grandfathering of benchmark-prefixed request aliases.

packet.unresolved_behavior: Existing staging/relations preserve incomplete and rejected proposals; no supplement or inferred mismatch.

schema.dynamic_ids: Schemas enumerate exact request-local IDs. Freeze builder plus probe; record generated schema hash for every future request.

assessment.requests: One per supplied profile batch with nonempty packets, maximum 32 covered candidates; none for all-empty profiles. Prepared only after provisioning settles.

stable_ids.candidate_order: SHA256([order_seed, ordinary opportunity_ref]); independent of supplied candidate order and legacy rank
stable_ids.scope: Opaque profile/opportunity/evidence IDs are deterministic within the same frozen request, not global IDs.

integration: Unchanged frozen ties_only: reorder covered slots only in contiguous equal legacy-score blocks; equal semantic values stable; empty/unavailable/invalid slots pinned.

failure.source_extraction_packet: Unavailable canonical packet retained; normal downstream positional fallback. Valid empty packet retained and reusable. No silent omission.
failure.invalid_caller_inputs: Reject before execution; caller retains legacy base, no implicit repair/substitution.
failure.dispatch: Exact endpoint/request allowlist and credential required; exclusive durable preclaim; no retry/redirect/repair. Completed matching journal replay only; uncertain prior attempt/result blocks resend.
failure.result_persistence: Failure retained, attempt claim prevents repeat; no ranking success asserted from an unpersisted response.

runtime_leakage_boundary.legacy: Only separate final integration input, never either provider request.

environment.model_reproducibility: Provider alias server revision is outside repository control; exact deterministic replay uses frozen raw responses.

offline_replay.assessment_fixture_hashes: Pinned by unchanged historical downstream manifest development_references.replay_inputs.

holdout_rule: From the containing freeze commit until a fresh replacement v2 is fully reviewed and unblinded, all evidence selection/binding, extraction prompt/schema/config/reuse, packets, assessment prompt/schema/config, validation, fit interpretation, integration, failures/fallbacks and model configurations are immutable. Any behavioral change after sampling requires invalidation, a new freeze commit, then a fresh universe.
